name: STS8600

evidence.excerpt: STS8600 主要应用于大规模SoC芯片（高速数字电路、高性能混合电路、微波/射频电路、通讯接口电路、CPU芯片等）的测试

notes: Product listing is not evidence of achieved HBM qualification, customer adoption or a specific installation count.

maturity_history.excerpt: 公司于 2023 年推出面向 SoC 及高端数字芯片的新一代测试平台 STS8600，持续推进客户端导入与验证工作，产品性能已得到客户验证认可，目前已进入小批量装机阶段。
maturity_history.notes: Issuer wording 小批量装机阶段, up from the FY2025 product listing. The R&D project table on p15 still prints 客户验证 for the 大规模 SoC 测试系统 project, so the two stages sit side by side. No unit count. SoC only: the filing gives STS8600 no memory, DRAM or HBM use.

name: STS8200AXE

evidence.excerpt: 公司与行业核心客户深度协同，推出归一化功率测试解决方案 STS8200AXE 系统。该系统凭借极低系统杂感技术与高性能动态参数测试能力，构筑行业领先的功率器件测试方案。

notes: Power-device test system on the STS8200 line, tied by the issuer to AI power-supply devices. 推出 is a launch statement; no shipment, customer or unit figure. Not memory, not HBM. Overlaps the STS8200 platform and is not additive.
